entries.text: Click the mic in the toolbar (or the Dictate tab on mobile) and markoto writes what you say into the document, at the cursor, while you speak.

entries.caption: Click the mic to start dictating
The mic lights up red, markoto is listening.

entries.text: The words land in the doc

The words appear as faint text at the cursor first; once a sentence is recognised, it becomes regular text in the document. Your collaborators see it arrive live, and undo removes it like anything you typed.

entries.caption: What you said is now part of the document, just like typed text.

entries.text: Stop the mic when you're done
Click the mic again to stop. The last words you said are written in, and the editor is back to keyboard-only input. Your browser remembers the mic permission, so starting again needs no new prompt.

entries.caption: Click the mic again to stop
The mic returns to its idle state, no more streaming.
